title: A Lipschitz image of ℝⁿ is covered by countably many C¹ images up to an Hⁿ-null set (Simon Ch. 3, proof of Lemma 1.2, displays (1)–(2))
statement: Let n, P ∈ ℕ (ℝᵏ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k); Hⁿ = μHE[n], Mathlib's Euclidean-normalised n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on ℝ^P) and let F : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be Lipschitz with constant K ≥ 0. Then there are C¹ maps G_i : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P (i ∈ ℕ) such that Hⁿ(F(ℝⁿ) ∖ ⋃_i G_i(ℝⁿ)) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n P : ℕ) (F : Eucl n → Eucl P) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K F → ∃ G : ℕ → Eucl n → Eucl P, (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G i)) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (range F \ ⋃ i, range (G i)) = 0
